title: Browse annotated rows and filter tags without losing context
summary: HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: the approved floating row exemplar and verification are complete. Judge density, tag vocabulary and query continuity at the canonical notebook.

verificationRecords.notes: Initial browser run: one passed, five failed. Test locators included native select options and one URL assertion used a relative path. Product issues: disabling an active registered toggle dropped transient keyboard ownership; explicit command names ranked below description mentions. Repairing focus at the transient boundary and exact-name match fields, with retained regression checks.

Initial run passed 74/75. Roadmap/thread exceeded existing 650/450-word budgets by two/three words; the first trim left one extra thread word. Shortened redundant prose without changing budgets; the final complete rerun passed.

10 tests passed: row field matching and exact ranges, Unicode source offsets, OR/AND/empty facets, stable identity through sort/narrowing, full 1369-row/eight-surface preservation, reference movement metadata, context-specific taxonomy and exact-name ranking.
Complete notebook/chat consumer passed after final integration.

Six Chromium cases passed on final integration: five-row paging and narrow-screen selected-row visibility, filters/sorting, retained PM identity/caret/mode/history, alias highlights, source/chat selections, streaming, delayed import cancellation and explicit reload recovery. Light/dark/narrow captures inspected.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:editor-chat -- --grep 'M-x and C-x|command picker keeps|command prefix cancels|fruit picker restores|note and composer Vim|late form'
verificationRecords.notes: Six existing command, source, fruit, note/composer history and late-form focus preservation cases passed. No original acceptance invariant was weakened.
75 tests passed on final source-linked roadmap/thread/dashboard. Prior commitment and support evidence retained; first floating exemplar precedes second-consumer promotion.
Final orientation passed and reports the selected row-picker contract at one of one complete, deferred for the named human checkpoint. Existing entrypoint budgets are unchanged.

revisitWhen: User reviews the row picker or requests a bounded adjustment; M-x adoption follows the exemplar judgment.
